ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems and allow System-C
missing_information: The pronoun 'their' in 'downstream systems' may refer to either 'System-A's own downstream systems' or 'the systems of the entities that work with System-A'. This creates two distinct interpretations based on the antecedent.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text introduces a referential ambiguity regarding who 'their' refers to. No textual cue is present to select one interpretation over the other.
